info.name: Document Extraction Local API
info.description:
Local Postman collection for the Document Extraction Workspace API.

Prerequisites:
1) From the repository root, run bun run build && bun run start.
2) Configure the Workspace model gateway in the browser and generate a Workspace API key.
3) Set api_key and template_id, or use template_tags for automatic selection. Choose one upload example and attach a PDF, PNG, JPEG, or WebP.

Smart splitting is a Workspace setting. Enabled PDF uploads return a packet_id; other uploads return a job_id. Upload scripts save poll_path from Location. Poll the submission, then follow each child_job_ids entry with Return Job Results. A packet always remains a packet in the API even when the UI shows a single document.

All product endpoints use Bearer API-key authentication; x-workspace-id is unnecessary. Full contract: mkdocs/docs/api/overview.md.

request.description:
Creates a template. Do not provide field IDs or object column keys; the API derives field IDs from field name and object column keys from column heading.

Expected: HTTP 201 with { template_id, version, status }.

Updates a template. Do not provide field IDs or object column keys; the API derives field IDs from field name and object column keys from column heading.

Expected: HTTP 200 with { template_id, version, status }.

Choose this example OR 1b and attach document. Expected: HTTP 202, Location, and either job_id or packet_id. Smart splitting still runs for PDFs with a specific template; all children inherit that template version. The script clears stale IDs and saves poll_path for Check Submission Status. Repeating an upload creates new work.

request.description: Alternative to 1a: omit template_id and send a nonempty JSON array of tag names. Templates matching ANY tag are candidates; every split child selects independently. Unknown tags match nothing and may require manual selection. Smart splitting uses the Workspace setting. The upload script saves either job_id or packet_id and poll_path. Repeating an upload creates new work.

exec: pm.test('Job or packet ID and poll location are returned', function () {

request.description: Poll the Location saved by the upload, normally every 2–5 seconds. Job states: queued, processing, awaiting_template, completed, failed. Packet states: queued, processing, awaiting_review, materializing, processing_children, completed, failed. A signed-in Workspace member must resolve review/template holds in the frontend before processing can continue; API keys cannot resolve them. Packet reads contain child summaries, not results. The script saves child_job_ids; copy each desired ID to job_id and read Return Job Results, tracking consumed IDs in your integration. A failed packet can still have successful or running children.

Read the ordinary job or one packet child. For a packet, set job_id to each ID in child_job_ids in turn. Completed jobs contain results; other states return results: []. A failed job still returns HTTP 200 with error_code/error_message. An awaiting_template job requires a signed-in Workspace member to choose a template in the frontend. API keys cannot resolve the hold. This example expects the chosen job to be completed.

exec: pm.test('Job should be completed for full results', function () {

request.description: Read the parent and its current children using packet_id saved at upload. Children contain job_id, status, parent_packet_id, and source_pages in the original PDF. Fetch each child job separately for extracted fields. A completed all-blank packet has outcome no_documents and no children.
Read effective enable_smart_splitting and exclude_blank_pages switches. API keys cannot change them; Workspace owners/admins use the browser. The upload captures these settings.
Download an available retained or held source. For a packet child this contains only its pages. Source errors do not change extraction results.
Download the full original when retained or still available for review. It includes excluded pages and deleted-child pages.
